refsect1.title: Description
refsect1.para: io.systemd.MachineImage is a Varlink interface implemented by systemd1-related components. It can be introspected and called with varlinkctl1.

refsect1.title: Interface Definition
refsect1.para: The following interface definition is exposed:
refsect1.programlisting:
interface io.systemd.MachineImage
# A enum field allowing to gracefully get metadata type AcquireMetadata( # Do not include metadata in the output no, # Include metadata in the output yes, # Include metadata in the output, but gracefully eat up errors graceful )
# A enum field allowing to control what type of images are cleaned up type CleanPoolMode( # Remove all unused images all, # Remove only hidden images hidden )
# List images # [Supports 'more' flag] method List( # If non-null the name of a image to report details on. name: ?string, # If true the output will include image metadata fields such as 'machineInfo' and 'OSRelease'. acquireMetadata: ?AcquireMetadata, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ( # Name of the image name: string, # The file system path where image is stored path: ?string, # The type of this image type: string, # The class of this image class: string, # Whether the image is read-only readOnly: bool, # The image creation timestamp creationTimestamp: ?int, # The image creation timestamp modificationTimestamp: ?int, # The image creation timestamp usage: ?int, # The image disk usage (exclusive) usageExclusive: ?int, # The image disk usage (exclusive) limit: ?int, # The image disk usage limit (exclusive) limitExclusive: ?int, # The hostname of the image hostname: ?string, # The machine ID of the image machineId: ?string, # Machine info information of an image. It contains an array of key value pairs read from the machine-info(5) file in the image. machineInfo: ?[]string, # OS release information of an image. It contains an array of key value pairs read from the os-release(5) file in the image. OSRelease: ?[]string )
# Update image allowing to rename, toggle read-only flag, or set a limit method Update( # The name of an image name: string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # If non-null the new name of the image newName: ?string, # If non-null value of the read-only flag of the image readOnly: ?bool, # If non-null value of image quota limit limit: ?int ) -> ()
# Clone image method Clone( # The name of an image name: string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # The new name of the image newName: string, # If non-null value of the read-only flag of the image readOnly: ?bool ) -> ()
# Remove image method Remove( # The name of an image name: string, # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool ) -> ()
# Sets an overall quota limit on the pool of images method SetPoolLimit( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # New image quota limit limit: int ) -> ()
# Clean unused images depending on the specified mode. Note that it does not process vendon and host images. # [Requires 'more' flag] method CleanPool( # Controls whether interactive authentication (via polkit) shall be allowed. If unspecified defaults to false. allowInteractiveAuthentication: ?bool, # Allows removing all or only hidden images mode: CleanPoolMode ) -> ( # Image name name: string, # The image disk usage (exclusive) usageExclusive: ?int )
# No matching image exists error NoSuchImage()
# Too many ongoing background operations error TooManyOperations()
# Requested operation is not supported error NotSupported()

refsect1.title: Examples
refsect1.para: varlinkctl introspect SERVICE io.systemd.MachineImage shows the interface definition as served by SERVICE, and varlinkctl call SERVICE io.systemd.MachineImage.List '{}' invokes its List method.
